                        $concat:
                        - $event: /sourcePath
                        - /payment/payment/reversed

            amountMinor:

        paid:

                  displayName: Guarantor

                  type: Parties/Party
                  displayName: Partner

              - seller
              - partner
              - guarantor

                authorizePayout:
                  'on': workflow
                  party: seller

                    requestId: payout-auth

                      $document: /paymentTerms/amountMinor

                  'on': workflow
                  party: seller
                  params:
                    requestId: payout-capture
                    amountMinor:
                      $document: /paymentTerms/amountMinor
        paymentTerms:
          amountMinor:
            type: Integer
          limitMinor:
            type: Integer
          currency: EUR
          payerChannel: seller
          payeeChannel: partner
          guarantorChannel: guarantor
          allowedPayees:
          - partner
          recipientApprovalRequired: false
      fieldPaths:

          party: seller
